source: Proposal S section 11 (params, annotations, title) and section 2 ('Description (shipped)', output models with the implementation contract's section 0.2 additions). Parameter descriptions are the shipped short forms: '($defs/<Type>)' pointers dropped, and null where S has none or where the text only restated the type (element_query.locator, pointer_click.target).

tools.name: session_start
tools.title: Start virtual KWin session
tools.description: Start an isolated virtual KWin Wayland session (one at a time). Then launch apps with app_launch.

params.name: screen_width
params.description: Virtual screen width, logical px.

params.name: screen_height
params.description: Virtual screen height, logical px.

params.name: enable_clipboard
params.description: Serve clipboard_* (off: wl-clipboard may hang).

params.name: home
params.description: HOME for launched apps: the host HOME, or a temporary isolated XDG HOME. Not a security sandbox.

params.name: retention
params.description: What survives the session end, decided now and honoured by session_stop and server exit.

tools.name: session_connect
tools.title: Attach to live KDE desktop
tools.description: Attach to an already running KWin session (the real desktop or a container). Actions then affect real applications; window_close asks the user first.

params.name: dbus_address
params.description: Session bus address; empty = $DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS.

params.name: wayland_display
params.description: Socket name or path; empty = $WAYLAND_DISPLAY.

params.name: enable_accessibility
params.description: Set org.a11y.Status.IsEnabled for the session lifetime; restored by session_stop.

params.name: retention
params.description: What survives the session end, decided now and honoured by session_stop and server exit.

tools.name: session_stop
tools.title: End session
tools.description: End the current session. Virtual: terminate KWin, launched apps and the bus. Live: detach, kill only apps launched through kwin-mcp, restore the a11y switch. Releases held input. Idempotent.

tools.name: session_info
tools.title: Session status
tools.description: Report the current session (or null), its enabled backends, and every app launched through kwin-mcp.

tools.name: app_launch
tools.title: Launch app in session
tools.description: Launch a program in the session (shlex-split, no shell). stdout/stderr go to a log read with app_log. A failed launch keeps the session.

params.name: command
params.description: Command line, e.g. "kate --new". Split with shlex; empty or unbalanced quotes is an error.

params.name: env
params.description: Extra environment variables for this process.

tools.name: app_log
tools.title: Read app output
tools.description: Return the tail of the captured stdout/stderr of an app launched with app_launch.

params.name: pid
params.description: PID returned by app_launch (session_info lists them).

params.name: last_n_lines
params.description: Trailing lines; 0 = whole log.

tools.name: screen_capture
tools.title: Capture screen
tools.description: Capture the workspace (or a rectangle of it) as PNG via KWin ScreenShot2 (Spectacle fallback). Returns the path and the image-to-logical coordinate mapping.

params.name: region
params.description: Crop rectangle in global logical px; null = whole workspace. Parts outside the workspace are dropped.

params.name: max_edge
params.description: Downscale so the longer side <= max_edge px; 0 = full resolution; null = server --screenshot-max-edge.

params.name: include_cursor
params.description: Draw the pointer into the image.

tools.name: element_query
tools.title: Query accessibility elements
tools.description: Return AT-SPI2 elements matching locator (pre-order) with rects, states, actions, window_id and a ref for targets. With wait, poll until present/absent.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Depth limit: 0 (or less) = application nodes only, 1 = top-level windows.

params.name: wait
params.description: Omit = read now; set = poll until the condition holds.

tools.name: element_act
tools.title: Invoke element action
tools.description: Invoke a named AT-SPI action on exactly one element: {ref}, or {strict: Locator} (strict search). Errors list the actions matches expose.

params.name: element
params.description: {ref} from element_query, or {strict: Locator}.

params.name: action
params.description: AT-SPI action name, case-insensitive, e.g. "Press", "Toggle", "Activate" (or "|"-separated fallbacks, e.g. "Press|click").

tools.name: window_list
tools.title: List windows
tools.description: List KWin windows (incl. dialogs/popups/shell) with id, kind, frame/client rects, capabilities and desktops. filter fields are AND-ed.

params.name: filter
params.description: Same selector as the window mutators, used as a filter; null = every window.

tools.name: desktop_list
tools.title: List virtual desktops
tools.description: List KWin virtual desktops in pager order with the current one marked.

tools.name: window_focus
tools.title: Activate window
tools.description: Raise and activate exactly one window (workspace.activeWindow).

params.name: window
params.description: Must match exactly one window; an ambiguous match is an error listing candidate ids.

tools.name: window_place
tools.title: Move window
tools.description: Set frame and/or virtual desktop of exactly one window, then read it back (KWin applies async). Refused with 'nothing was changed' when transients would also move.

params.name: window
params.description: Must match exactly one window; an ambiguous match is an error listing candidate ids.

params.name: frame
params.description: New outer frame, global logical px; omitted fields kept; size <= workspace.

params.name: desktop
params.description: Move to this virtual desktop id (from desktop_list).

tools.name: window_close
tools.title: Close window
tools.description: Ask exactly one window to close (app may refuse). On a live session the user must confirm; unconfirmed, not closeable or unknown = non-error refusal.

params.name: window
params.description: Must match exactly one window; an ambiguous match is an error listing candidate ids.

tools.name: pointer_click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Move the pointer to a target and click 1-3 times, optionally holding modifier keys and holding the last press.

params.name: count
params.description: 1 single, 2 double, 3 triple.

params.name: modifiers
params.description: Modifier keys held during the click, e.g. "ctrl+shift".

params.name: hold_ms
params.description: Press duration of the last click (long-press); min 25 ms.

tools.name: pointer_move
tools.title: Move pointer
tools.description: Move the pointer onto a target and leave it there (hover, tooltips).

tools.name: pointer_scroll
tools.title: Scroll
tools.description: Move to a target and scroll the wheel.

params.name: delta
params.description: Amount in `unit`; positive = down/right, negative = up/left.

params.name: unit
params.description: smooth_step = 15 px smooth scroll per unit; detent = one wheel click.

params.name: steps
params.description: Split delta into this many increments, 10 ms apart.

tools.name: pointer_drag
tools.title: Drag
tools.description: Press a mouse button at one target, move through optional waypoints, release at another. The button and modifiers are always released, even on error.

params.name: from
params.description: Start target.

params.name: to
params.description: End target.

params.name: modifiers
params.description: Modifier keys held during the drag.

params.name: waypoints
params.description: Intermediate points {x, y, dwell_ms}; the pointer pauses dwell_ms at each.

params.name: dwell_ms
params.description: Pause at `to` before releasing (drop targets that need hover).

tools.name: pointer_hold
tools.title: Hold or release mouse button
tools.description: Press, move or release one mouse button across calls (custom drags). Each phase moves to target first. Held input stays until released, session_stop or exit; every result reports held input. Gestures never touch a held control.

params.name: phase
params.description: press (no-op if held); move (button must be held); release (always sent).

params.name: target
params.description: the pointer moves here first.

tools.name: keyboard_press
tools.title: Press key combo
tools.description: Press and release one key or chord at the keyboard focus.

params.name: keys
params.description: e.g. "Return", "ctrl+c", "alt+F4", "shift+ctrl+z"; unknown key names are an error.

tools.name: keyboard_type
tools.title: Type text
tools.description: Insert text at the keyboard focus. keys = per-key US-QWERTY events (rejects other characters before sending anything); unicode = wtype, else a private clipboard paste that restores the previous selection.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to insert.

params.name: method
params.description: keys = per-key events, US-QWERTY only (else error: retry method="unicode"); unicode = any text, may paste.

tools.name: keyboard_hold
tools.title: Hold or release keys
tools.description: Press or release one key chord across calls (modifiers first on press, reverse on release). Held input stays until released, session_stop or exit; every result reports it.

params.name: keys
params.description: Any key or full chord, modifiers then key, e.g. "shift", "ctrl+shift", "a", "ctrl+Return".

tools.name: touch_tap
tools.title: Tap
tools.description: Tap a target with one touch contact (does not move the pointer).

params.name: hold_ms
params.description: Contact duration, min 10 ms; >500 = long-press.

tools.name: touch_swipe
tools.title: Swipe
tools.description: Swipe with N parallel contacts from one target to another. Contacts are spread vertically 20 px apart around the path. KWin consumes >=3-finger swipes as global gestures.

params.name: from
params.description: Start (centre of the contact group).

params.name: to
params.description: End.

params.name: fingers
params.description: Number of parallel contacts.

params.name: duration_ms
params.description: Travel time; 10 ms per step.

tools.name: touch_pinch
tools.title: Pinch
tools.description: Two contacts move symmetrically toward or away from a centre (pinch in / zoom out).

params.name: center
params.description: Pinch centre.

params.name: start_distance
params.description: Initial contact distance, px.

params.name: end_distance
params.description: Final distance (< start = pinch in).

params.name: duration_ms
params.description: Gesture duration.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.title: Read clipboard
tools.description: Return the session clipboard text (wl-paste). Virtual sessions need enable_clipboard.

tools.name: clipboard_write
tools.title: Write clipboard
tools.description: Own the session clipboard with this text (wl-copy, waits up to 5 s for ownership). Virtual sessions need enable_clipboard.

params.name: text
params.description: Any text, including NUL.

tools.name: dbus_call
tools.title: Call D-Bus method
tools.description: Escape hatch: call any method on the session bus. The declared signature is introspected (Qt overloads supported). Prefer the dedicated tools.

params.name: service
params.description: Bus name, e.g. org.kde.KWin.

params.name: path
params.description: Object path.

params.name: args
params.description: dbus-send strings ("int32:5") and/or typed JSON {type, value, element_type?}, mixable.

tools.name: wayland_list
tools.title: List Wayland globals
tools.description: Escape hatch: list the Wayland protocol globals the compositor advertises (wayland-info).

params.name: filter
params.description: Keep raw lines containing this (case-sensitive).
